places.name: Kaffeerakete Stuttgart
places.description: Kaffeerakete Stuttgart is a specialty coffee place in Stuttgart that roasts its own beans. The menu includes espresso drinks and filter coffee. It also sells beans to take home.

places.name: abnorm concept space
places.description: abnorm concept space is a place in Stuttgart that serves specialty coffee. It serves coffee from Südhang, Stray, Ordinary and HALBSTARK. The menu includes espresso drinks and filter coffee, with plant-based milk available. It also sells beans to take home and sells brewing equipment.
